##### Project general facts

Redwood Lakeside is an exclusive villa development, funded through the Singapore-based investment fund Diamond 3.0 Investments. This contemporary project offers a collection of private three and four-bedroom villas, each thoughtfully designed with functional layouts and high-quality finishes. Set around a scenic lake, the development blends serene natural beauty with modern island living.

Residents enjoy access to a range of well-appointed facilities, including a cozy café, a modern co-working space, a fitness center, a children’s play area, and scenic recreational paths. Round-the-clock security ensures peace of mind. Every element is designed to foster a balanced lifestyle of relaxation, productivity, and community connection.

Every villa at Redwood Lakeside features contemporary interiors with high-quality finishes and spacious layouts. Open-plan living and dining areas flow seamlessly to outdoor spaces, creating bright, airy environments perfect for relaxation and entertaining. Kitchens are fully appointed, and bedrooms offer generous comfort. Eco-efficient technologies, including solar panels and smart home integration, enhance sustainability and energy savings.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the tranquil Cherng Talay area of Thalang, this exceptional location places residents within easy reach of Phuket’s most desirable beaches, including Bang Tao and Surin. The neighborhood is renowned for its serene atmosphere, scenic lakes, and proximity to world-class lifestyle destinations such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and connectivity. Premier shopping, fine dining, international schools, and top-tier hospitals are just minutes away. Phuket International Airport is within a comfortable drive, ensuring effortless travel for residents and guests.

For those seeking a residence that embodies lakeside tranquility, modern convenience, and strong investment potential, Cherng Talay delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, five-star amenities, and a prestigious address makes it one of Phuket’s most desirable locations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
